description:
Job Description – DevOps AI Agent Engineer (Claude SDK / AWS AgentCore / GitHub Actions) 
 Duration: 3+ Months (Extension Possible) 
 Experience: 12+ years overall, including hands-on GenAI or agentic AI development.
 Key responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and implement AI agents using the Claude Agent SDK (formerly Claude Code SDK).
 Build agent workflows using Python or TypeScript, including tool calling, MCP integrations, and API orchestration.
 Deploy and manage AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime.
 Develop automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for agent builds, testing, and deployments.
 Configure AWS IAM, ECR, Docker/container packaging where applicable, and cloud security.
 Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize production AI agent performance.
 Implement secure authentication, logging, monitoring, and observability.
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
